digest.component_or_area: ticket close gate and disposition system
propositions: Operators force-close ~25 administrative-disposition tickets (duplicate/obsolete/superseded/wontfix) per week because the completion verifier cannot pass them and no truthful exit path is discoverable from the failure message.
Non-bug tickets (task/story/epic) have no valid way to close with administrative dispositions today; obsolete/wontfix are gated to bugs only via close_precheck.py:64.
The close-failure message never mentions the existing narrow --class path (limited to 3 values on bugs) and does not enumerate applicable disposition values for the ticket type.

Administrative close classes (duplicate/obsolete/superseded/wontfix) must skip completion verification, demand replacement links or reasons as appropriate, and persist a signed disposition attestation distinct from force-close metadata.
The --reason flag is force-only today; reason-capable administrative classes (obsolete/wontfix) must reuse it without --force and thread it as close_reason through the event and state.
The close_precheck refusal message must enumerate the allowed --class values per ticket type and hint the disposition alternative to --force, making the truthful exit discoverable.
